title: bugsmith result
description: Machine-readable outcome of a bugsmith run. Emitted at the end of every run (Step 12) and returned as the bug-fixer agent's payload. Stable contract for headless callers (e.g. VegaTools).

status.description: opened_pr: PR created. dry_run: full run, no push. skipped: triage gate declined (medium/hard in autonomous). failed: an error or a failing test that couldn't be resolved. needs_human: blocked on a decision only a human can make.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation. Required when status is skipped/failed/needs_human.

verification.description: One entry per verification check attempted.

check.description: e.g. unit, backend-unit, e2e-affected, typecheck, pre-pr, lint

detail.description: For skipped: exactly what was missing (creds/emulator/server/browser).

followUps.description: Deliberately-deferred work (e.g. a defense-in-depth backend guard).

alerts.description: Loud notices the caller/human must see, e.g. 'E2E skipped: no staging creds'.
